segments.sn22.136:1.2: “Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, kukkuḷaṃ, vedanā kukkuḷā, saññā kukkuḷā, saṅkhārā kukkuḷā, viññāṇaṃ kukkuḷaṃ.
segments.sn22.136:1.3: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn22.136:1.4: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn22.136:1.5: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: 136-149. Kukkuḷavaggassa paṭhame kukkuḷanti santattaṃ ādittaṃ chārikarāsiṃ viya mahāpariḷāhaṃ.
Imasmiṃ sutte dukkhalakkhaṇaṃ kathitaṃ, sesesu aniccalakkhaṇādīni.

136-149. Anto aggi mahanto chārikarāsi, tattha ukkuḷavikulato akkamantaṃ yāva kesaggaṃ anudahatāya kucchitaṃ kuḷanti kukkuḷaṃ, rūpavedanādi pana tatopi kañci kālaṃ anudahanato mahāpariḷāhanaṭṭhena ca kukkuḷaṃ viyāti kukkuḷaṃ.
